children: Alpha Wave Ventures LP, a global private equity fund managed by Alpha Wave Ventures GP, has sold shares worth Rs 1,705 crore in multinational eyewear company Lenskart Solutions through open-market transactions.
Lenskart Solutions shares appeared to react negatively to the large transaction, falling 4.33 percent to close at Rs 648.30, their lowest closing level since August 28, amid heavy trading volumes.

Alpha Wave Ventures LP sold 2.64 crore equity shares, representing 1.51 percent of Lenskart Solutions' paid-up equity, for Rs 1,704.8 crore. The shares were sold at an average price of Rs 645.31 apiece.
The stake sale was part of the 2.88 percent holding, equivalent to 5 crore equity shares, held by Alpha Wave Ventures as of September 2026.
Dalmia Bharat Refractories buys 1.07 percent stake in Religare Enterprises; Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund pares holding
Dalmia Bharat Refractories has acquired 36.64 lakh shares, representing 1.07 percent of Religare Enterprises' paid-up equity, for Rs 79.15 crore at Rs 216 per share.
Meanwhile, Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund sold 46.19 lakh shares, equivalent to 1.35 percent of the company's paid-up equity, for Rs 99.83 crore at an average price of Rs 216.12 per share.
As of June 2026, Motilal Oswal Large and Midcap Fund held a 4.42 percent stake in Religare Enterprises, the financial services holding company.
Religare Enterprises shares gained 1.93 percent to close at Rs 221.78, supported by significant trading volumes on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

On the daily chart, the stock appeared to form a potential Tweezer Bottom pattern following a sharp downtrend. This candlestick formation can signal a bullish reversal, although confirmation from subsequent price action is generally required.
Axana Estates acquires 0.67 percent stake in Northern Arc Capital

Axana Estates LLP, backed by Arpit Khandelwal of Plutus Wealth Management LLP and Mithun Sacheti of CaratLane, has acquired 10.96 lakh shares, representing 0.67 percent of non-banking finance company Northern Arc Capital's paid-up equity, for Rs 31.56 crore at Rs 288 per share.
Northern Arc Capital shares rose 2.01 percent to Rs 287.10, supported by above-average trading volumes on the NSE.

title: Alpha Wave Ventures pares Lenskart Solutions stake worth Rs 1,705 crore
